snippet.title: Paradigm: Reboot - 3D Rhythm Game | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Paradigm: Reboot is coming this summer!
Get ready for new content and features, including new game tracks from your favorite artists!
*Available on App Store and Google Play from summer 2022.
